_comment: Row 296. Re-run from a detached scratch copy with toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row296_vpn_runner_gate_holds.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. The complete four-state caller denominator covers no VPN configured, measured down, raised measurement, and unavailable module. The separate transform-control spec applies the byte-identical M1 regression to an import-only node and must ESCAPE.
subject: the runner admits only an explicit VPN-ready result and refuses or rechecks every unmeasurable state

mutants.label: M1 grant VPN permission when the measurement raises
M2 restore the missing-runtime bypass
mutants.old:
if not _VPN_RUNTIME_AVAILABLE:
                # The soft import cannot tell us whether this site requires a
                # tunnel.  Refuse the worker before browser launch instead of
                # treating an unavailable admission instrument as permission.
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "vpn runtime unavailable; refusing worker startup")
mutants.new:
if False and not _VPN_RUNTIME_AVAILABLE:
                # The soft import cannot tell us whether this site requires a
                # tunnel.  Refuse the worker before browser launch instead of
                # treating an unavailable admission instrument as permission.
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "vpn runtime unavailable; refusing worker startup")

mutants.label: M3 wait once but then fall through instead of rechecking
mutants.old:
if not vpn_ready:
                    # Down and unavailable are both holds.  Only an explicit
                    # True (including the no-VPN-configured fast path) admits.
                    self._stop.wait(30)
                    continue

mutants.label: M4 over-hold a site whose VPN runtime explicitly admits it
mutants.new:
vpn_ready = bool(vpn_runtime.maybe_wait_for_vpn(
                        self.site_id, timeout=30.0)) and False
